env_scope.description: Environment restriction of the presented API credential, or an empty string.

dispatch.description: native or unsupported; Workers answers 501 for dispatch.

ChainedAuditEntry.description: Audit database row. Emergency-locked workspaces return empty detail and omit hash and prev_hash. Legacy unchained rows have seq=0.

anyOf.description: The value is redacted when either side of the change is sealed.
The value is redacted when either side of the change is sealed.

ChangeRequestInput.description: Unique environments and logical secrets only. Between 1 and 500 total writes/deletes. Keys are trimmed and uppercased. Targets must be accessible SSE environments in the same workspace.

revision.description: Required for PUT; must equal current revision.

sync_errors.description: Present for actions, keyed by environment on apply; empty for approve/reject.

wrapped_key.description: Client-generated environment key wrapped for the caller. Omission or an empty string uses the server-generated compatibility path, which is not server-blind.

path.description: Legacy plaintext path, used only when path_enc is empty.

EnvironmentCreate.description: Delegated mode requires runner_id, wrapped_key and runner_wrapped_key, with a runner in the same organisation.

mode.description: delegated selects client encryption with a runner; other values use server-side encryption.

EnvironmentPolicy.description: Supply at least one of restricted, require_approval or max_versions.

url.description: Invocation URL; POST signed Standard Webhooks messages here.

secret.description: whsec_-prefixed signing secret, shown exactly once.

Instance.description: Instance authentication settings and caller ownership flag. Provider boolean fields reflect credential configuration, while methods lists enabled authentication methods.

invite_token.description: Single-use redemption token for the share link.

invite_url.description: Full redemption URL with the token fragment.

LdapConfig.description: When no LDAP configuration exists only configured=false is returned. group_roles is a semicolon-separated string of Group=role pairs, not a JSON map.

value.description: Decrypted lease value; an empty string is returned if decryption fails.

command.description: Ready SSH command for instabox leases.

database.description: Connectable database name for planetscale leases.

host.description: Connection host for planetscale and instabox leases.

password.description: Present for postgres, mysql and planetscale.

remote_id.description: Present for provider child keys and PlanetScale and Instabox credentials.

username.description: Present for postgres, mysql and planetscale.

value.description: Generic token or provider child secret; absent for database, AWS, PlanetScale and Instabox leases.

renewable.description: True only when not revoked and not expired.

LockboxShareRequest.description: The selected value must be nonempty.

secrets.description: Only the first item's value is used, taking precedence over text.

recovery_codes.description: Only included on enrollment verification; null if recovery codes already exist.

mfa_token.description: Challenge token returned by a login that requires a second factor.

locked.description: True locks the workspace; false restores it.

OrgRole.description: Managed roles have managed=true and no id. Custom roles have an id and omit managed. Custom permissions are returned as stored JSON; the creation handler does not validate their shape.

OrgSecuritySettings.description: Admin-visible settings. During emergency lockdown only ip_allowlist and reuse_check are returned. The OIDC client secret is never returned.

options.description: WebAuthn CreationChallengeResponse serialized by webauthn-rs, containing publicKey creation options.

rules.description: Ordered rules evaluated per secret path.

RotationHook.description: When no hook exists only configured=false is returned.

config.description: Empty means local random rotation. Adapters: webhook (rotation_url), resend (api_key), openrouter (management_key), openai (admin_key, project_id, service_account_id). Provider URLs pass egress validation.

claim.description: Must match the active claim returned by jobs.

text.description: Parsed as dotenv only when secrets is empty.

keys.description: Optional key names or path-qualified names, trimmed and uppercased.

expected_version.description: 0 means create-only; n requires current version n. Mismatch returns 409.

current.description: True when this session served the request.

id.description: Stable id used to revoke the session.

current.description: True when the deleted session served the request.

existing.description: Present only if the same hostname/key pair was already registered.

hostname.description: Literal dot-separated alphanumeric/hyphen labels, each 1-63 characters, no leading/trailing hyphens or wildcards.

ttl.description: Used only for sign-host; clamped to 60-7776000 seconds.

public_key.description: OpenSSH public key, never a private key.

ttl.description: Clamped to 60 seconds through the role grant maximum, at most 28800 seconds.

StepUpChallenge.description: Without TOTP, two_factor returns only not_required=true and methods=[]. Otherwise returns challenge, risk, methods and email_sent.

expires_at.description: Unix seconds; zero means no expiry.

expires_in.description: Positive values are clamped to 60-31536000 seconds. Nonpositive values create a non-expiring token.

scopes.description: Comma or whitespace separated secrets:read, secrets:write, org:admin, transit:manage, transit:encrypt, transit:decrypt, transit:rewrap or *. Empty preserves legacy scope behavior.

ciphertext.description: Required for decrypt and rewrap; canonical owt1 envelope.

context.description: At most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; exact context required for decryption.

plaintext.description: Required for encrypt, base64 encoding of at most 1048576 bytes.

error_code.description: Safe failure code; never a provider response body.

event_id.description: Stable event id; deduplicate on it.

status.description: pending, processing, delivered, failed, dead_lettered or cancelled.

message_id.description: webhook-id header of the accepted message.

outcome.description: Truncated sync outcome message after processing.

status.description: pending, processing, delivered, failed, dead_lettered or cancelled.

body.description: Decrypted captured payload; null when not captured or erased by master-key rotation.

id.description: Receipt id; inspect it via the receipts endpoints.

public_key.description: New Ed25519 public key for asymmetric subscriptions.

secret.description: New signing secret, shown exactly once.

app_id.description: Application scope; empty means the entire workspace.

disabled_reason.description: Set when the subscription auto-paused after repeated dead-lettered deliveries.

public_key.description: whpk_-prefixed Ed25519 public key, present for asymmetric subscriptions.

secret.description: whsec_-prefixed signing secret, shown exactly once.

event_id.description: Stable event id the receiver can deduplicate on.

jwks_url.description: Optional; fetched instead of the inline JWKS.

bound_claims.description: Exact claim matches; reserved JWT claims are forbidden. Maximum serialized size 16384 bytes. Claim names and values must be nonempty, bounded and control-free.

jwks.description: Inline public asymmetric signature keys only, RSA or P-256/P-384 EC. No remote key fetching, private keys or symmetric keys. Maximum serialized size 65536 bytes; kid values must be unique.

info.description: Public REST surface used by the SDKs and the Terraform provider. Authentication is a bearer session token, service token, or OAuth access token. All paths are relative to the instance origin. Advanced browser and protocol surfaces (OAuth authorization, MCP transport, SCIM, PKI issuance, browser asset bundles) are intentionally not part of this contract; device PKI lifecycle routes are documented.
